about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Investing in the human capital of Rwanda's youth since 1999.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Founded in September 1999 in Butare (Huye), Rwanda, Groupe Nos Enfants (GNE) was born from the vision of Father Modeste Mungwarareba, Dr. Laurien Ntezimana, and Ms. Antoinette Bruttin. Emerging in the aftermath of the 1994 Genocide, GNE was established to contribute to national reconstruction by focusing on the protection and empowerment of vulnerable children and youth.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To unlock the human potential of vulnerable youth through integrated solutions combining knowledge, hands-on skills, and entrepreneurship.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: A society where every child and young person is protected, enjoys equal opportunities, and becomes a self-reliant driver of sustainable development.

programs.title: Our Programs & Services
programs.subtitle: Providing integrated solutions to unlock the potential of Rwanda's youth.

list.title: Scholarship Programme
list.description: Academic support for gifted but vulnerable youth in secondary education, ensuring that financial barriers don't stand in the way of excellence.

list.title: Vocational Training (FormPro)
list.description: Career orientation and a intensive 6-month skills cycle designed for school dropouts to gain practical, marketable skills.

list.title: Dignity for Young Mothers
list.description: Comprehensive reintegration and economic empowerment programs for adolescent mothers, helping them rebuild their lives and support their children.

list.title: Social Incubation (ICYARI/NEST)
list.description: Business incubation and mentorship for women entrepreneurs in agribusiness and crafts, fostering innovation and self-reliance.
